title: Alder Parlour
description: A cello-like lower voice asks the first question alone. The upper voice answers a bar late, gradually borrowing the bass rhythm. A flat-side conversation opens into warmer sixths; the first question returns under a changed reply and the lower voice takes the final word.
technical_note: Let each hand finish its own sentence. The exposed lower line needs connected finger legato without a heavy bass attack. Voice the upper sixths softly; the few pedal spans colour arrivals without filling the written gaps.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
